page_text_en: Gua Ji Guan and Heng Heng Bear Go Fishing
summary_zh: 本页展示了绘本的标题页，标题为《呱唧罐和哼哼熊钓鱼》，背景为橙色，配有模糊的插图。

title_en: 29 Quack Quack Badger and Hum Hum Bear Go Fishing
page_text_ocr_zh:
呱唧獾爱讲话，从早到晚嘴巴呱
唧呱唧停不下来；哼哼熊呢，不喜欢
讲话，就爱独自轻轻地哼哼歌。
性格脾气不同，并不好碍他们成
为一对朋友。
那一天，呱唧獾和哼哼熊约着一
起去河边钓鱼。
他们把钓竿伸向河心，不住地瞧
瞧漂在河面上的鱼漂。
呱唧獾开始呱唧呱唧
地讲着一个个故事，可是
哼哼熊一句也
没搭理。
002
003
page_text_en:
Guaji the badger loves to talk, from morning till night, his mouth goes 'guaji guaji' without stopping; Hengheng the bear, on the other hand, doesn't like talking, and just enjoys quietly humming songs to himself.
Their personalities and tempers are different, and it's not easy for them to become friends.
One day, Guaji the badger and Hengheng the bear made plans to go fishing by the river.
They extended their fishing rods toward the center of the river, constantly watching the float bobbing on the water's surface.
Guaji the badger started chattering away, telling one story after another, but
Hengheng the bear didn't respond a single word.
002
003
summary_zh: 本页介绍了呱唧獾和哼哼熊的性格差异，并描述了他们一起去河边钓鱼时，呱唧獾不停讲故事，而哼哼熊却一句话也不回应的场景。

title_en: 29 Quack Quack Badger and Hum Hum Bear Go Fishing
page_text_ocr_zh:
钓了半天没钓到鱼。哼哼熊说："瞧你，呱唧个没完，鱼都被你吓跑了！"
就在这时，只见哼哼熊的鱼漂动了，他一提钓竿，钓上了一条很大的鱼。
“谁说我把鱼吓跑了。这不，一条喜欢听我讲故事的鱼来了！"
呱唧獾同情地瞧着那条鱼，说："你是因为爱听我讲故事，才赶来的吗？"
鱼的嘴巴一张一合，一张一合，仿佛在说："是的，是的……"
哼哼熊想把鱼扔进鱼篓里。
鱼的嘴巴还在不住地动着，呱唧
page_text_en:
They'd been fishing for half a day without catching anything. Hengheng Bear said: "Look at you, never stopping with your stories, you've scared all the fish away!"
Just then, Hengheng Bear's float moved. He lifted his rod and caught a big fish.
"Who said I scared the fish away? Look, here comes a fish who loves listening to my stories!"
Guajiji Badger looked at the fish sympathetically and said: "Did you come because you love listening to my stories?"
The fish's mouth opened and closed, opened and closed, as if saying: "Yes, yes..."
Hengheng Bear wanted to throw the fish into the basket.

summary_zh: 哼哼熊抱怨呱唧獾讲故事吓跑了鱼，但自己却钓上了一条大鱼。呱唧獾认为这条鱼是因喜欢听他讲故事才来的，鱼的嘴巴一张一合仿佛在回应，哼哼熊想把鱼扔进鱼篓。

title_en: 29 Quack Quack Badger and Hum Hum Bear Go Fishing
page_text_ocr_zh:
獾说：“多可怜，一条爱听故事的鱼。”
呱唧獾央求哼哼熊说：“这条鱼
是我的朋友，你放了它吧，我会谢谢你
的！”
哼哼熊没法拒绝老朋友的
请求，他放走了鱼。
钓鱼。
为了也钓到一条
鱼，呱唧獾专心注视着
鱼漂，不再呱唧。可是
这时候，哼哼熊却忍不住独自哼哼起
歌来：“水波儿，水波儿，哩哩，藏着小
鱼儿，小鱼儿，哩哩……”
钓了半天没钓上鱼，呱唧獾忍不住了：“哩哩什么呀，鱼都让你唱跑了！”
page_text_en:
The badger said, "How pitiful, a fish that loves to listen to stories."
Gua Ji Badger pleaded with Heng Heng Bear: "This fish is my friend. Let it go, and I'll thank you!"
Heng Heng Bear couldn't refuse his old friend's request, so he let the fish go.
Fishing.
To catch a fish too, Gua Ji Badger focused intently on the float, no longer chattering. But then,
Heng Heng Bear couldn't help but hum to himself:
"Water waves, water waves, li-li, hiding little fish, little fish, li-li..."
After fishing for half a day without catching anything, Gua Ji Badger couldn't stand it anymore: "What are you humming about? You've scared all the fish away!"
summary_zh: 呱唧獾请求哼哼熊放走一条爱听故事的鱼，哼哼熊同意了。之后两人继续钓鱼，呱唧獾专注看鱼漂，而哼哼熊忍不住哼歌，结果一条鱼也没钓到，呱唧獾抱怨哼哼熊的歌声吓跑了鱼。

title_en: 29 Quack Quack Badger and Hum Hum Bear Go Fishing
page_text_ocr_zh:
也就在这时候，呱唧獾的鱼漂动了，他一提钓竿，鱼钩上一条鱼在扑腾着。
“多可怜，这一定是条爱哼哼的鱼，我哼哼的歌吸引了它。”哼哼熊说。
呱唧獾拿下了鱼，鱼的嘴巴还在一张一合，仿佛在唱它最后的歌。
哼哼熊忍不住对呱唧獾说：“我也求求你，放了我爱哼哼的朋友吧！”
呱唧獾瞧了老朋友一眼，二话不说把鱼放回了河里。
page_text_en:
Just then, Guaji Badger's fishing float moved. He lifted his rod, and a fish was wriggling on the hook.
"Poor thing, this must be a fish that loves to hum. My humming song attracted it," Humming Bear said.
Guaji Badger took the fish off the hook. Its mouth was still opening and closing, as if singing its last song.
Humming Bear couldn't help but say to Guaji Badger, "I beg you, let my humming friend go!"
Guaji Badger glanced at his old friend, said nothing, and released the fish back into the river.
summary_zh: 呱唧獾钓到一条鱼，哼哼熊认为是自己的哼唱吸引了鱼，请求放生，呱唧獾同意并把鱼放回河里。

title_en: 29 Quack Quack Badger and Hum Hum Bear Go Fishing
page_text_ocr_zh:
接下来,两个朋友再也没有钓到
一条鱼。
当他们扛着钓竿,提着空空的鱼
篓走在回家的路上时,他们的心情很
快乐——
呱唧獾依旧讲他呱唧呱唧的故
事,哼哼熊呢,轻轻地哼着自己心爱
的歌……
page_text_en:
Next, the two friends didn't catch a single fish.
When they carried their fishing rods and held their empty fish baskets on the way home, they were very happy—
Gua Ji Huan still told his Gua Ji Gua Ji stories, while Heng Heng Bear softly hummed his favorite song...
summary_zh: 呱唧獾和哼哼熊一无所获地回家，虽然没钓到鱼，但两人的心情依然快乐，呱唧獾继续讲故事，哼哼熊则哼着歌。
